evidence.evidence_text: These changes are widely attributed to the growing influence of Large Language Models (LLMs), which frequently rely on a distinct lexical style.
We analyzed lexical trends before and after ChatGPT's release in 2022, focusing on commonly LLM-associated words.
To explore this question, we constructed a dataset of 22.1 million words from unscripted spoken language drawn from conversational science and technology podcasts.
